jobs.title: 2D Designer
jobs.summary: Design brand identities, event graphics, signage and campaign artwork that move from screen to real environments.
requirements: Strong portfolio across print and digital brand work
Fluent in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign
An eye for typography, layout and colour
Able to iterate quickly against real deadlines

jobs.title: 3D Exhibition Stand Designer
jobs.summary: Design exhibition stands and brand environments in 3D — from concept renders to technically buildable spaces.
requirements: Portfolio of exhibition or interior 3D design
Proficiency in 3ds Max, SketchUp or similar, plus V-Ray or equivalent
Understanding of fabrication methods and materials
Able to translate a brief into a spatial story
Collaboration with production teams through build

jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.summary: Grow Elite Marcom's client base across exhibitions, events and branding — owning relationships from first call to signed project.
requirements: Experience selling services in events, exhibitions, media or agencies
Confident presenting to marketing and procurement teams
Fluent English; Arabic is an advantage
Driven by targets and long-term relationships
